text_summary: Replaced primary flange gasket on upper nozzle N2 of V-204B. Torque sequence applied per OEM spec at 280 Nm in star pattern. Previous gasket showed visible extrusion and H2S discolouration on the ID face. Post-replacement leak test passed at 1.1x design pressure with no detectable emissions on LDAR survey.

Vibration trending on C-14 drive-end bearing showed gradual increase from 6.2 to 11.8 mm/s over 8 weeks. Bearing SKF 6316-2RS replaced during planned outage. Shaft alignment checked and corrected from 0.12 mm to 0.03 mm offset. Post-repair vibration baseline recorded at 3.1 mm/s. Seal flush system inspected — no anomalies found at this time.

Pressure relief valve PRV-101 removed for bench testing. Set pressure found at 104% of nameplate (10.4 barg vs. 10.0 barg design). Valve reseated poorly on two of three test cycles — spring pack replaced and valve recertified at 10.0 ± 0.2 barg. Inlet and outlet piping inspected for deposits; light scale found and cleaned.

Scheduled descaling of HX-110 tube bundle using 5% citric acid circulation for 6 hours. Pre-cleaning ΔT across tube side was 42°C; post-cleaning ΔT restored to 28°C (design: 25°C). Bundle pulled for visual inspection — no tube pitting or wall thinning detected. Baffles and tie rods intact. Recommended next descale interval reduced from 12 months to 6 months based on fouling rate trend.

Ultrasonic thickness survey of V-302A shell and nozzle welds. Minimum wall thickness measured at 8.2 mm (original 12 mm, retirement thickness 7.5 mm). Corrosion rate calculated at 0.38 mm/year on lower shell course, accelerated from 0.25 mm/year measured in 2022. Recommended internal coating application at next turnaround. Flange gasket on N4 nozzle noted as original 2018 installation — flagged for replacement.

Level transmitter LT-301A recalibrated after field verification showed zero-point drift of +3.2% of span. Root cause traced to moisture ingress in the transmitter junction box. Junction box re-sealed and desiccant replaced. Independent high-level switch LSHH-301 verified functional — maintenance override tag from WO-2025-02085 confirmed cleared and switch returned to service.

Replaced double mechanical seal (John Crane Type 2800) on PP-205 outboard end. Old seal faces showed carbon tracking and 0.15 mm wear beyond service limit. Seal flush plan 54 verified — flush pressure differential confirmed at 2.5 bar above process (minimum 2.0 bar). Drain valve on seal flush line tagged for closure verification on post-maintenance checklist.

Routine catalyst bed inspection on R-501. Thermocouple survey identified a 35°C hotspot in the lower third of the catalyst bed, consistent with localised channelling. Catalyst screening showed 8% fines accumulation. Standby cooling water pump P-501B impeller inspected — found to rotate freely with no binding. Auto-start interlock tested satisfactorily at this date. Recommended: reduce catalyst change-out interval from 24 months to 18 months.
